profile.headline: Software Engineer | Former Software Engineering Manager | Ruby on Rails · SQL · AWS | Remote | Team Building & Mentorship
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer with 5+ years of experience building and scaling applications with Ruby on Rails, React, SQL, and AWS. I’ve worked fully remote across distributed teams, delivering production systems and collaborating closely with product, QA, and design.

I’ve also served as a Software Engineering Manager, leading development across multiple applications, guiding technical decisions, mentoring engineers, and launching an internal mentorship program. I enjoy staying hands-on while supporting team growth and engineering culture.

My focus is backend and full-stack engineering with Ruby on Rails and APIs, combined with my experience in technical leadership and mentoring engineers through team growth and change. I’m currently expanding into Python for backend services and data workflows.

Outside of my day-to-day role, I’m active in the tech community as a former Director of Women Who Code Dallas, a volunteer with Latinas in Tech DFW, a maintainer for RailsGuides.es, and a contributor to Latina.dev.

I’m open to remote software engineering roles where I can contribute both technically and through leadership and mentorship.
